richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel hose.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK WITH RISK OF FIRE

richiami.difetto: Non-conformant front brake master cylinders have been installed on a specific batch vehicles. These non-conformant parts may have a defective hydraulic circuit which in certain conditions may result in longer than normal braking distances.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the batch number of the front brake master cylinder. Where a master cylinder from the affected batch is found it will be replaced.

richiami.difetto: The fastening which fixes the front sprocket to the gearbox output shaft may slacken and cause abnormal noise to occur from the nearside of the engine. If the noise is not heard or ignored eventually the rear wheel will lock. This will increase the risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the diameter of the recess on the secondary gearbox shaft. Fit a revised sprocket fastener kit or where necessary fit both a new secondary shaft to the gearbox and a revised sprocket fastener kit.

richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected machines to check and if require place the fuel pump.

richiami.difetto: The front brake line may chafe against the oil supply pipe and leak fluid. In the worst case the performance of the front brake will rapidly diminish.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to fit a plastic guard.

richiami.difetto: The engine may lose performance/stall due to valve/s dropping due to premature wear of the valve cap.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the upper cups of the intake and exhaust valves.

richiami.difetto: The engine may fail without warning due to the connecting rods not being to the correct specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit a new quality assured engine unit.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that on subject machines cracking of both main frame members can occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will be fitted with a steel support in the subject area.

richiami.difetto: It has been found that some fuel tank ventilation valves are not to the required specification. This concern could lead to a build up of pressure and the fuel tank expanding. If this happens the tank could come into contact with the rear wheel and wear through.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affect to replace the fuel tank ventilation valve.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK COULD INFLATE CAUSING CONTACT WITH THE REAR WHEEL

richiami.difetto: The efficiency of the front brake could be compromised by poor machining of the brake pipes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to replace the brake pipes with a quality assured product.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that road debris and or stones can enter the throttle body and obstruct the throttle linkage causing the throttle to remain open.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected machine to fit protective cover to throttle body assembly and where necessary replace throttle cable body and upgrade the ECU software.
richiami.titolo: THROTTLE MAY NOT CLOSE DUE TO THE INGESTION OF DEBRIS

richiami.difetto: Engine may stall and/or exhibit abnormal running.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected machines check and if necessary replace throttle body TPS sensor.

richiami.difetto: Engine may stall and/or exhibit abnormal running.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that some Sport City machines could display a problem with the fuel level sensor ring nut which may under certain conditions result in a fuel leak.
richiami.rimedio: On machines which are likely to develop the problem the fuel tank will be changed.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the rear swinging arm could crack.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the swinging arm.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that in some instances a link within the drive chain may break under particular riding conditions and after high mileage.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines which have covered less than 12000km will have the chain replaced. Machines which have covered in excess of 12000km's will have the chain and sprockets replaced.

richiami.difetto: The return spring pin for the side stand is not to specification and could fail. This will allow the side side to drop down whilst the machine is being ridden.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a new side stand.
richiami.titolo: THE RETURN SPRING PIN ON THE SIDE STAND MAY FAIL AND THE STAND MAY GO DOWN

richiami.difetto: An out of tolerance internal spacer within the front forks can if it reaches maximum compression not return to its original position.  This could cause difficulties in control of the machine.
richiami.modello: CAPONORD RALLY RAID , CAPONORD RALLY RAID
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected machines and replace the internal spacer with the correct specification one.
richiami.titolo: FRONT FORKS MAY NOT RETURN TO NORMAL RIDE POSITION.

richiami.difetto: Incorrect specification inner valve springs have been fitted to the engine inlet and exhaust valves. Failure of the engine could result.
richiami.rimedio: Fit replacement inner valve springs.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECT VALVE SPRINGS FITTED TO ENGINE

richiami.difetto: The hydraulic fluid in the front brake system may not be to the correct specification. This could result in a reduction in the effectiveness of the brake under conditions of hard use.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected motorcycles drain hydraulic fluid from front brakes refill with DOT4 specification fluid and bleed brakes.

richiami.difetto: The steering head welding connection to the frame main tube may break and affect the directional control of the moped.
